name: Gryphon
timbre: big, rough, hoarse man's voice, hearty and gravelly, with a raucous cracking shriek when excited
pitch: bass-baritone, booming, jumping to a hoarse falsetto yell at peaks
accent: working-class London Cockney: dropped h's, broad vowels, glottal stops
